name: schoolfood
description: SchoolFood: lệnh gốc cho chạy local và deploy EC2 (SF38). Script ec2:* chạy trên máy chủ Linux, cần file .env.prod.

scripts.local:migrate: docker compose exec backend python manage.py migrate
scripts.local:check: docker compose exec backend python manage.py check && docker compose exec backend python manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run
scripts.ec2:check: docker compose --env-file .env.prod -f compose.prod.yaml exec -T backend python manage.py check --deploy
scripts.ec2:db:backup: mkdir -p backups && docker compose --env-file .env.prod -f compose.prod.yaml exec -T db sh -c 'pg_dump -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -Fc' > backups/schoolfood-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).dump
scripts.ec2:migrate: npm run ec2:db:backup && docker compose --env-file .env.prod -f compose.prod.yaml exec -T backend python manage.py migrate
scripts.ec2:createsuperuser: docker compose --env-file .env.prod -f compose.prod.yaml exec backend python manage.py createsuperuser
scripts.ec2:ledger-audit: docker compose --env-file .env.prod -f compose.prod.yaml exec -T backend python manage.py sf31_ledger_audit --strict
scripts.ec2:deploy: git pull --ff-only && npm run ec2:build && npm run ec2:up && npm run ec2:migrate && npm run ec2:check && npm run ec2:ledger-audit
